{"content": [{"cache_prompt": false, "type": "text", "text": "#!/bin/bash
# zephyr-run <board> [extra west args...]: build the current Zephyr app and run its test suite, stopping
# the emulator as soon as the suite reports "PROJECT EXECUTION ..." (QEMU keeps running otherwise).
# Same build command the evaluator uses: west build -b <board> -d /tmp/build -p always -t run .
unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH
board="${1:?usage: zephyr-run <board>}"; shift
log=/tmp/zephyr-run.log
: > "$log"
( timeout 900 west build -b "$board" -d /tmp/build -p always -t run . "$@" 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/zephyr-run.pid; wait ) \
  | while IFS= read -r line; do
      printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$log"; printf '%s\n' "$line"
      case "$line" in *"PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL"*|*"PROJECT EXECUTION FAILED"*)
        pkill -f qemu-system 2>/dev/null; pkill -f zephyr.exe 2>/dev/null; break;; esac
    done
echo "[zephyr-run] full log: $log""}], "is_error": false, "command": "cat $(which zephyr-run)", "exit_code": 0, "timeout": false, "metadata": {"exit_code": 0, "pid": -1, "username": "root", "hostname": "7af7b3f12970", "working_dir": "/zephyrproject/zephyr/tests/drivers/dac/dac_emul", "py_interpreter_path": "/opt/python/venv/bin/python", "prefix": "", "suffix": "
